name: Exact Positive Spectral Value on a Maximum Class
statement: The sixteen-state maximum class $C_\ast$ satisfies $\delta_{\mathrm{sp}}(C_\ast)=1/\sqrt2$ and $\tau(C_\ast)=2^{-1/4}$. Thus it is convex-realizable but has no strict term-dominance certificate.
proof: Two negative source cycles force $\beta\ge\max(\sqrt{ab},\sqrt{cd})$, while a positive closed path choice forces $\alpha\le\sqrt{ab+cd}$, giving the lower bound $1/\sqrt2$. A rational array has $\alpha^2=9/8$ and $\beta^2=9/16$, attaining it. Every nontrivial reflection has a missing pattern with at least two positive literals, so the displayed orientation is the only union-closed one.
